generated_middle_practice.rule: Middle practice may be purpose-authored/generated at artifact build time from the Assessment Plan, Question Structure, canonical source items, representations, and misconceptions. It must not invent new assessed content.

abundance_and_repetition: Purposeful Algebra repetition remains good. Do not maximize shell variety or run an anti-clone rewrite simply because values/structures repeat.
response_mode: constructed/open response by default; game formats may use selected response when explicitly authorized.
representation_rule: Render the actual graph/table/context/diagram students must use. Do not replace a needed representation with prose.
count_note: Do not use legacy 24/24/24/24/6 counts as current authority. New counts are a Bank/Practice PM decision to be made from the revised map.
